title: Student photos, bank details stolen by hackers after St James Anglican School in Perth hit by cyber attack
content_md: Emma Kirk reports: A school in Perth’s north has been targeted in a cyber attack, with hackers stealing students and families’ personal information. St James Anglican School, in Perth’s north, identified a cyber breach involving unauthorised access into its computer systems.
